svg.text: Four fills, four outcomes — every curve measured, none drawn
solid = Q% (left axis) · dashed = A_valley, the turbidity (right axis) · the ring is the reported answer
A · THE MUDDY FILL — the case this is all for
it clears 10-fold in the beam; Q% falls with it, turns, and the VERTEX is the answer
A_valley never falls, Q% never turns — the FIRST look is the answer and the run is short
A_valley RISES — ripening, not settling. TEST C ends the run: a value, but not a settled one
D · ⛔ THE OPAQUE FILL — and why a ceiling is owed
read through mud at A_valley 2.67 and reported 8.45 — a confident GREEN on a brown oil
